name: B10-0212/2024 (ECR) – Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Hong Kong, notably the cases of Jimmy Lai and the 45 activists recently convicted under the national security law
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for Jimmy Lai and the 45 Hong Kong democrats convicted in November 2024 to be freed at once and all charges dropped. It says Hong Kong's rights and rule of law have got much worse since China's security laws came in, and asks Hong Kong to scrap those laws. It also asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Hong Kong and Chinese officials and to review Hong Kong's trade offices in Europe.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking, not deciding; the Council and EU bodies would have to act.
- **Who it affects:** Jimmy Lai, the 45 convicted activists, other detainees, and Hong Kong and Chinese officials who could face sanctions.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Hong Kong and Chinese governments; the Council is urged to adopt sanctions.
